en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a historic Italian square. On the right stands a large Romanesque cathedral with an octagonal dome, rose window, arched colonnade, and side portico. To the left are old palazzi and a crenellated civic tower. In the foreground is an ornate fountain topped by a Neptune statue. A few people are seen walking in the square with mountains in the distant background. Caption text is printed along the bottom border.
